parsed.reason: Description A says the except InventoryError branch re-raises without releasing the connection to the pool, so rejected reservations leak pool connections. Description B says non-inventory exceptions skip rollback, leaving partial updates uncommitted on the connection. Both touch the same except block, but A's failure is a pool connection leak on InventoryError while B's is a missing rollback on other exceptions; these are different failures.
